cases.name: zip strict=False StopIteration at input 0
cases.source:
events=[]
stop=StopIteration('payload')
class I:
 def __init__(self,n): self.n=n; self.i=0
 def __iter__(self): events.append(('iter',self.n)); return self
 def __next__(self):
  self.i+=1
  events.append(('next',self.n,self.i))
  if self.n==0 and self.i==1: raise stop
  if self.i>3: raise StopIteration
  return self.n*10+self.i
r=zip(I(0),I(1),I(2),strict=False)
result=[]
for unused in range(4):
 try: result.append(('value',next(r)))
 except Exception as e: result.append(('error',type(e).__name__,e.args,e is stop))
result.append(events)
